zh.title: 中華航空9月起於法蘭克福及紐澳等航線推出全新商務艙餐具
zh.summary: 中華航空宣布9月1日起於法蘭克福、布拉格及紐澳航線豪華商務艙上線全新餐具。
body: 中華航空於2026年8月20日宣布，將自9月1日起推出全新豪華商務艙與商務艙餐具。新餐具以紅梅意象為主要設計元素，首波將於法蘭克福、布拉格，以及雪梨、布里斯本、墨爾本與奧克蘭等紐澳航線的豪華商務艙正式亮相。
華航本次再次攜手台灣品牌「JIA品家」合作，共同打造超過30個品項的全新餐具系列，涵蓋主菜盤、多功能碟、不鏽鋼餐具與玻璃杯等品項。設計團隊將傳統元素融入機能，傳遞溫暖團聚的氛圍。
系列中最具特色的項目包含葫蘆型奶油碟與筷架二合一餐具、紅燈籠造型的鹽罐與胡椒罐，以及取材自飛機螺旋槳設計的三合一餐匙，結合甜點匙、茶匙與奶油刀功能。

en.title: China Airlines to Launch New Business Class Tableware on Long-Haul Routes in September
en.summary: China Airlines will launch new business class tableware on September 1 across selected European and Oceania routes.
body: China Airlines announced on August 20 that it will launch a new tableware collection for its premium business class starting September 1. The new service will feature red plum blossom design motifs and will be introduced on routes including Frankfurt, Prague, Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne, and Auckland.

The airline partnered with Taiwanese design brand JIA Inc. to develop the collection, which comprises over 30 individual items including main course plates, multi-functional dishes, stainless steel cutlery, and glassware.

Key elements in the new lineup include a gourd-shaped two-in-one butter dish and chopstick rest, red lantern-shaped salt and pepper shakers, and a propeller-inspired three-in-one spoon combining a dessert spoon, tea spoon, and butter knife.

zh.title: 台灣首批兩架F-16V戰機自美國起飛前往志航基地
zh.summary: 台灣採購的首批兩架F-16V戰機已自美國起飛，預計近期飛抵台東志航基地。
body: 台灣向美國籌購的首批兩架F-16V Block 70戰鬥機（機號6727與6728），已於美東時間2026年8月17日自美國起飛，預計近期飛抵台灣。這兩架戰機在跨太平洋飛行途中將實施空中加油並進行整備停留，以因應機員體能與航程限制。
本次交付屬於台灣「鳳翔專案」計畫，空軍共編列新台幣2472億元預算向美方採購66架全新的F-16V戰機。受產線搬遷及供應鏈中斷等因素影響，交付進度有所延宕；剩餘63架預計於2027至2028年間交付，未來將全數部署於台東志航基地。
此外，洛克希德馬丁與漢翔公司已於2023年12月完成「鳳展專案」，將台灣現役的140架F-16A/B戰機成功升級為F-16V構型。

en.title: Taiwan's First Two F-16V Block 70 Fighter Jets Depart US for Delivery Flight
en.summary: Taiwan's first two F-16V Block 70 fighter jets have departed the US for delivery to Taitung.
body: The first two of 66 F-16V Block 70 fighter jets purchased by Taiwan, bearing serial numbers 6727 and 6728, departed the United States on August 17, 2026, Eastern Time, and are expected to arrive in Taiwan soon. The trans-Pacific flight involves aerial refueling and a maintenance stop to accommodate pilot endurance and aircraft performance limits.

The procurement is conducted under Taiwan's "Peace Phoenix Soaring" program, budgeted at NT$247.2 billion ($7.74 billion). Deliveries were delayed from the original 2023-2024 schedule due to production line relocation and aerospace supply chain disruptions. The remaining 63 aircraft are scheduled for delivery through 2027 and 2028, with the full fleet to be stationed at Zhihang Air Base in Taitung.
Separately, under the "Peace Phoenix Rising" program, Lockheed Martin and AIDC upgraded 140 existing F-16A/B jets to the F-16V configuration, completing the work in December 2023.
